name: Keep build-local identity explicit
counterexamples_or_limits: Friendly canonical names must not erase build-local addresses.
scan_recipe: Carry build,address,auto-name,canonical-name,homology-group separately.

name: Raw control flow outranks broken decompiler boundaries
counterexamples_or_limits: Use only where raw bytes/assembly can resolve the disputed boundary.
scan_recipe: Compare raw bytes/branches/returns against decompiler body before semantic naming.

name: Historical reports are locators, not fresh proof
counterexamples_or_limits: Prior accepted claims may be reused only at exact accepted scope.
scan_recipe: Use old material to locate addresses, then recheck primary evidence for promotion.

name: Preserve disproven interpretations
counterexamples_or_limits: A rejected story can be superseded when genuinely new discriminating evidence appears.
scan_recipe: Record negative constraint and superseding evidence instead of deleting history.

name: Track the real receiver
counterexamples_or_limits: Nearby ctor/dtor calls do not type an unrelated incoming pointer.
scan_recipe: Track ECX/this or exact stack-local address across each load-bearing edge.

name: Callback/table targets survive export omissions
counterexamples_or_limits: A literal code-looking address still needs raw executable confirmation.
scan_recipe: Seed raw target recovery from pointer literals even when functions.csv has no row.

name: Opaque calls are continuity barriers
counterexamples_or_limits: Continuity can be restored by explicit preservation/reacquisition proof.
scan_recipe: Split symbols at opaque calls and prove identity/value continuity before rejoining.

name: Reacquisition creates a new logical generation
counterexamples_or_limits: Same generation may later be proved by stable root/lifetime evidence.
scan_recipe: Name repeated results R1,R2... until identity continuity is established.

name: Maintain explicit stack-coordinate bases
counterexamples_or_limits: Decompiler locals are acceptable only after manual coordinate reconciliation.
scan_recipe: Record entry-ESP/current-ESP transforms and recompute argument/local offsets.

name: Reconstruct raw ABI before assigning semantics
counterexamples_or_limits: Friendly signature may be restored after raw register/out-param behavior is known.
scan_recipe: Classify EAX/AL/AX/out-param/address/ignored return shapes.

name: Preserve width and signedness literally
scope: packed IDs, flags, thresholds, byte events
counterexamples_or_limits: Do not widen or reinterpret until consumer behavior justifies it.
scan_recipe: Track truncation, sign/zero extension, ordered/unordered comparisons and threshold inclusivity.

name: Restore split/truncated functions before semantics
counterexamples_or_limits: Only needed when visible body boundary is load-bearing or implausible.
scan_recipe: Recover continuation with raw branches, callers/callees and neighboring blocks.

name: Keep numeric domains separate until equality edge
counterexamples_or_limits: Domains may merge after explicit equality/copy/provenance edge.
scan_recipe: Assign symbolic domain names before friendly semantics.

name: Normal return does not prove semantic success
counterexamples_or_limits: Explicit status/result validation can prove success.
scan_recipe: Locate the first validated status/result consumer before using success language.

name: Classify reference kind before ownership reasoning
counterexamples_or_limits: Some values can change representation across an explicit conversion boundary.
scan_recipe: Use resolver/release/sentinel/arithmetic/dereference behavior to classify.

name: Same offset across unrelated classes is not shared semantics
counterexamples_or_limits: Shared semantics require typed family evidence, not offset coincidence.
scan_recipe: Type receiver first, then compare offset use within the family.

name: Same numeric state across subsystems is not shared meaning
counterexamples_or_limits: Shared meaning can be established only by typed producer/consumer equivalence.
scan_recipe: Use typed receiver+field+writer+value+consumer as semantic key.

name: Bound a gate to the exact controlled region
counterexamples_or_limits: Broader mode semantics need independent evidence.
scan_recipe: Mark branch start/end and list operations skipped vs still executed.

name: Equal stride or size is not type identity
counterexamples_or_limits: Merge only with matching provenance, layout and consumers.
scan_recipe: Compare initialization, fields and consumers before merging equal-size records.

name: Separate finalizer registration, cleanup availability, invocation and free
counterexamples_or_limits: An exact invoked destructor+allocator free path can close the chain.
scan_recipe: Record each lifecycle milestone independently.

name: Retention is not ownership
counterexamples_or_limits: Ownership may be established by matching creation/release/free responsibilities.
scan_recipe: Track creator,retainer,releaser,freer separately.

name: Clear/reset/unlink is not free
counterexamples_or_limits: A subsequent exact free can establish destruction.
scan_recipe: Search allocator/deallocator and pointee destructor separately from reset.
notes: Reset is a lifecycle edge, not free.

name: Retirement marker/event is not deletion
counterexamples_or_limits: Scope is current CRdObject-family evidence, not every engine event2.
scan_recipe: Separate marker/event2, manager unlink, destructor and free.

name: Staging or cache publication is not freshness
counterexamples_or_limits: Freshness can be proven by explicit invalidation/producer-before-consumer ordering.
scan_recipe: Track producer generation, invalidation, bypass paths and consumer generation.

name: Static call order is not runtime concurrency proof
counterexamples_or_limits: Synchronous direct calls do establish local immediate order.
scan_recipe: Separate instruction-order facts from OS scheduling/cadence/quiescence claims.

name: Repeated registration is not automatically idempotent
counterexamples_or_limits: A different helper may be idempotent if duplicate handling is explicitly proven.
scan_recipe: Inspect duplicate registration behavior and old-handle release before calling ensure.

name: Start typed-resource work at a verified seam
counterexamples_or_limits: Unverified extension strings are only locators.
scan_recipe: Follow exact typed branch from callback/factory to first discriminating consumer.

name: Collect resource identity tuple before naming type
counterexamples_or_limits: Not every branch exposes every tuple element.
scan_recipe: Collect extension,helpers,allocation,vtable,parser magic,handoff,consumer.

name: Keep archive,manager,child,cache,utility records distinct
counterexamples_or_limits: Merge only with explicit shared-object/provenance evidence.
scan_recipe: Track allocation source, owner, stride, lifecycle and consumer separately.

name: Reconstruct managers as lifecycle clusters
counterexamples_or_limits: A partial cluster can remain candidate-only.
scan_recipe: Inspect ctor args,table,callback,locks,population,root,update,cleanup.

name: Reconstruct child records through discriminating consumers
counterexamples_or_limits: Friendly field names wait for discriminating consumers.
scan_recipe: Start at initialization and enumerate all helpers/consumers of child base.

name: Homology requires structural anchors
counterexamples_or_limits: Address proximity alone is never enough.
scan_recipe: Compare role,constants,fields,vtable,calls,strings,CFG.

name: Regional address deltas are candidate priors only
counterexamples_or_limits: Current distribution can change as ledger grows; never use delta as proof.
scan_recipe: Rank regional delta candidates then structurally verify.
notes: 260 verified pairs; top10 deltas cover ~88.1% in seq55 snapshot.

name: Prefer paired narrow slices when cross-build confidence matters
counterexamples_or_limits: Mechanism discovery may intentionally be Steam-first if debt is recorded.
scan_recipe: Use matched bounded slices where homology/artifact detection is the immediate goal.

name: Coarsely classify obvious external/runtime code and move on
counterexamples_or_limits: Do not skip game-owned wrappers around external APIs.
scan_recipe: Assign coarse ownership once adequate evidence exists.

name: Promote game-owned roots only from concrete anchors
counterexamples_or_limits: High-reference global alone is insufficient.
scan_recipe: Require initializer/static receiver/lifecycle/vtable/table or repeated typed cluster.

name: Use global clusters as joins not labels
counterexamples_or_limits: A global can bridge unrelated phases through reuse; owner must be verified.
scan_recipe: Aggregate readers/writers then verify initializer,receiver and consumers.

name: Prefer cross-subsystem edges over isolated leaf helpers
counterexamples_or_limits: Leaf helpers can be chosen when they provide a unique discriminator.
scan_recipe: Rank producer->mechanism->consumer boundaries across subsystem lines.

name: Centrality ranks targets but does not name them
counterexamples_or_limits: Naming needs typed/lifecycle/boundary evidence.
scan_recipe: Use centrality for scheduling only.

name: Sourcecards and handoffs are locators not promotion artifacts
counterexamples_or_limits: Can reuse accepted claims at exact scope.
scan_recipe: Re-derive mechanism from primary evidence in ordinary batch.

name: Reuse accepted claims only at exact scope
counterexamples_or_limits: New evidence can widen scope through a new reviewed claim.
scan_recipe: Quote/reuse only the precise typed/root/boundary fact already accepted.

name: Distinguish unvisited,not-found,bounded-static,disproven
counterexamples_or_limits: A bounded scan closes only its documented grammar.
scan_recipe: Record exact search grammar and reopen discriminator.

name: Metrics are not semantic closure
counterexamples_or_limits: Metrics remain useful for workload tracking.
scan_recipe: Keep semantic exit criteria independent from raw count/byte/function percentages.

name: Reassess globally after coherent mechanism gain
counterexamples_or_limits: Continue locally only when global comparison selects the same frontier.
scan_recipe: Compare independent families after each coherent gain before following warm locators.

name: Three non-discriminating revisits trigger BLOCKED
counterexamples_or_limits: A genuinely new discriminator resets the value of revisiting.
scan_recipe: After repeated equivalent searches, state exact missing evidence and block.

name: Keep checkpoints concise but complete
counterexamples_or_limits: Checkpoint is continuity metadata, not semantic proof by itself.
scan_recipe: Record universe,targets,changes,scope,limits,counters,validation,next action.

name: CRdObject/native-task adapter signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Event meanings and +0x44 are family-scoped; event2 is not delete.
scan_recipe: Seed callback setter/factory, recover event map, phase slot and retirement edges.

name: Scheduled adapter to separate controller receiver switch
counterexamples_or_limits: Global access alone is insufficient; require explicit receiver switch.
scan_recipe: Find callbacks that save incoming task then load static/root ECX before class work.

name: Active-object field cluster
counterexamples_or_limits: No single offset is diagnostic across unrelated classes.
scan_recipe: Score multiple field behaviors plus registration/vtable family.

name: Embedded helper vs independently registered object
counterexamples_or_limits: A helper can still have ctor/dtor/vtable; independence needs its own registration/root lifecycle.
scan_recipe: Check independent handle/list/root registration before promoting entity status.

name: In-place static service/root signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Deleting dtor does not imply static heap ownership; finalizer registration is not invocation.
scan_recipe: Scan init shims for absolute .data receiver -> ctor -> same-receiver finalizer.

name: Lazy singleton getter signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Decompiler may call getter void; singleton capability does not exclude other instances.
scan_recipe: Find cache/null/alloc/ctor/publish/EAX-return shape and verify raw ABI.

name: Singleton-capable class may have independent instances
counterexamples_or_limits: Currently strongest in audio; do not universalize instance count.
scan_recipe: Track constructor/vtable identity separately from root/allocation provenance.

name: CThfunc OS-worker signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Available start path does not prove live runtime activation.
scan_recipe: Enumerate generic start-helper callers; recover receiver RTTI and slot+4 target.

name: Fixed-stride manager/record-array signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Equal stride/count does not establish type identity.
scan_recipe: Rank stride arithmetic,count/capacity,sentinel init,indexing,cleanup,root retention.

name: Requested/pending vs current/committed pair
counterexamples_or_limits: Human state meaning remains unknown until typed consumers discriminate it.
scan_recipe: Search compare -> side effect -> copy/commit between same-domain fields.

name: Packed handle signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Do not apply to arbitrary numeric indices/tokens.
scan_recipe: Look for sentinel,resolver,release,generation/index packing and non-direct dereference.

name: Scheduler-sensitive vtable fingerprint
counterexamples_or_limits: Slot semantics are family/phase specific; shared target alone cannot name class.
scan_recipe: Cluster override/shared targets at known phase/lifecycle slots with factory context.

name: Callback event-map/jump-table signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Event numbers remain local without typed producers/consumers.
scan_recipe: Literal callback -> raw block -> low-byte map -> target table -> receiver analysis.

name: Actor/model resource binding signature
counterexamples_or_limits: Suffix does not prove concrete returned class, success or ownership.
scan_recipe: Seed .XMD/.XPC formatting + CRdData lookup + same-object slot publication.

name: Model/cache production pipeline
counterexamples_or_limits: Valid cache can bypass producer; freshness/final GPU submission remain separate.
scan_recipe: Separate input/state prep,evaluation,cache,packet population,scene handoff.

name: Persistent-bit hysteresis recognizer
counterexamples_or_limits: Only one typed subsystem currently proves this exact policy; units/meaning unknown.
scan_recipe: Look for prior-bit branch + two thresholds + preserve-between behavior.

name: Latch producer/test/clear handshake
counterexamples_or_limits: Exact latch meaning, freshness and last writer remain local.
scan_recipe: Cluster writer,test,conditional action,clear and downstream guard.

name: Publication before validation/null-gate
counterexamples_or_limits: Not every store is pre-validation; inspect exact order.
scan_recipe: Order store,status/null test,first dereference; label published/validated/consumed separately.

name: Regional Steam to GOG address-delta ranking
counterexamples_or_limits: Standalone delta has zero homology authority; distribution changes as ledger grows.
scan_recipe: Learn per-region delta histogram, rank candidates, require structural verification.
